description: This file defines the ImportService class responsible for importing books from Goodreads format into the system. It handles transformation of input data, validation, and saving books via BookService, including handling authors, shelves, and ratings.

classes.name: ImportService
classes.description: Service class for importing bookshelf data from Goodreads format, converting them into internal model objects, and saving them.

methods.name: importGoodreadsBooks
methods.description: Main method that takes Goodreads-formatted book imports and processes them into saved Book entities.

methods.name: toBooks
methods.description: Converts a collection of GoodreadsBookImport objects into a list of Book objects.

methods.name: toBook
methods.description: Converts a single GoodreadsBookImport into an Optional<Book> after validation and data transformation.

methods.name: toAuthor
methods.description: Creates an Author object from a name string if not blank.

methods.name: toPredefinedShelf
methods.description: Determines the predefined shelf based on shelf name and read date.

methods.name: toCustomShelf
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a UserCreatedShelf if the shelf name indicates a custom shelf.

methods.name: toRatingScale
methods.description: Converts a rating value to internal RatingScale format, scaling as necessary.
